toc.title: Magnifico et amplissimo viro, Dn. Salomoni Hirtzelio, Reipublicæ Tigurinæ Quæstori prudentissimo, patri: nec non pietate religio
Caput XIX. De sacramentis in genere. Iuxta declarationem Capitis XIX. Confessionis Helveticæ.
Caput XXI. De sacra cœna Domini.

book: A 1629 Zurich disputation, the Diatribe de sacramentis in genere et specie, built as a dedication followed by three chapters (XIX–XXI) of the Confessio Helvetica, each split into numbered theses with proofs, and closing with a coronis.
